name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Success | Sales Handoff to Go-Live, HubSpot, Customer Communications
summary: Customer onboarding professional who keeps every account moving from sales handoff to go-live without dropped details. Managed about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak at Wix, retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, and keeps HubSpot and notes current so anyone can pick up where I left off. Comfortable learning technical topics fast, coordinating between customers and technical teams, and working outside normal hours when the situation calls for it.

experience.title: Client Onboarding & Success (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Run each new client from kickoff to go-live: discovery, collecting the information and access I need, following up until it's complete, and keeping the client updated on dates and next steps.
Document every interaction, timeline, and action item in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion so records stay complete across concurrent clients.
Built automated reminders and follow-up workflows (20+ in GoHighLevel) so customer communications go out on time without manual chasing.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and supported 15-20 reseller partners across 50+ daily activities, retaining all but one (~94%).
Watched partner utilization to catch problems early, followed up until issues were resolved, and escalated structured issues to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built processes that reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery, tracking work in HubSpot, Monday.com, and ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets, managing about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak.
Ran kickoff and launch calls, aiming to get each client live on the first call and scoping multi-session plans for complex builds.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 and improved the onboarding process for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and handed them to the implementation team, escalating risks early.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
